_about: Conventions for the chart tool. Source: design spec section 8 and ebook page 12 (orbs), 14 (moon phases), 15 (counts). Items marked 'writer call' may be changed by the owner. The Python oracle (daily-oracle-repo scripts/make_oracle.py) and the browser code both read this file.
retrograde: sign of the longitude speed; Sun, Moon and nodes never marked

orbs.rule: max when Sun or Moon is one of the two bodies, otherwise min

patterns.bodies: the 10 planets only (no Ascendant, Midheaven, Chiron or nodes)
patterns.orbs: same orb rule as aspects; major aspects, plus quincunx for the yod
patterns.stellium: 3 or more planets in one sign
patterns.grandTrine: three planets all trine each other
patterns.grandCross: four planets: two oppositions, four squares
patterns.yod: one sextile plus two quincunxes meeting at the tip
patterns.kite: grand trine plus a fourth planet opposite one corner and sextile to the other two
patterns.suppress: a T-square inside a grand cross, and a grand trine inside a kite, are not listed separately

vertex: Ascendant formula for the colatitude (90 - latitude) with RAMC + 180
